UPDATE 2026-11-10 08:07Z (Termal::Fable2): w-1d8a8991b237's fix (the revision-only binding refresh, landed in combo30 d6a359fc) is LIVE on every host since the 2026-11-10 restarts. All hosts run a6978c03 or later.

Do NOT use the rename workaround after an `update … revise` any more. Two live revisions (Sol-a7bb on w-6cbc, Sol-edfd on w-c26c) caused no scope change. The rename also has a side effect: the first capture after it records `assumed_missing_baseline` (w-4c0e2500b010).

If after a revise the host still shows runtime_observation_scope_changed, or `done` refuses `unconfirmed_declaration`, report it to Termal::Fable2 as w-1d8a counter-evidence instead of renaming.

This memory is kept only until w-1d8a's criterion 3 live case (a done without re-evaluation after a revise) is recorded; then delete it.

Previous text (superseded): after any revise, re-name the same source root, end the turn and continue next turn.
